note: Round 24 MAJOR correction: MTR definition standardized to first-grid-point theta_i (= upper crossing endpoint). The paper's prior 0.365/0.119/-3.52 regression and band [7.8e-5,2.4e-4] came from the geometric-midpoint sqrt(theta_lo*theta_hi) with sqrt(stiff) normalization; the text said 'first grid point' + 'stiff^0.365', a triple mismatch. Recomputing with theta_i makes GAP (not stiffness) the driver. Regenerated by make_fig3_kband_v2.py (base-10 log-log, bootstrap 95% intervals from 10^4 matched resamples).
